typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Category as string,
		AssetType as string,
		AssetClass as string,
		ProductCategory as string,
		SubProductCategory as string,
		ProductID as string,
		ParentProductID as string,
		InstrumentType as string,
		ProductCreatedBy as string,
		HID as string,
		Quantity as string,
		EqSwapNotional as string,
		TradingAccount as string,
		Desk as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> InvalidProductHierarchy
InvalidProductHierarchy derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		HID as string,
		Category as string,
		InstrumentType as string,
		Quantity as double,
		ProductID as string,
		AssetType as string,
		ParentProductID as string,
		SubProductCategory as string,
		ProductCategory as string,
		ProductCreatedBy as string,
		EqSwapNotional as string,
		Desk as string,
		TradingAccount as string,
		AssetClass as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		HID,
		Category,
		InstrumentType,
		Quantity,
		ProductID,
		AssetType,
		ParentProductID,
		SubProductCategory,
		ProductCategory,
		ProductCreatedBy,
		EqSwapNotional,
		Desk,
		TradingAccount,
		AssetClass),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
